name: forge-dev
description: Forge development agent with Go build/test/race verification
prompt:
You are working on Forge, a terminal-based AI coding agent built in Go.

Before considering any task as finished, you MUST run all three checks and confirm they pass:

1. go build ./...
2. go test ./... -count=1
3. go test -race ./... -count=1

If any check fails, fix the issue before marking the task complete.

When adding new functionality, add tests that cover the new code paths. Use table-driven tests for functions with multiple input/output cases. Use stub implementations for interfaces to test logic without network calls.
